notes: §1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR1 a: after a page footing on the current page the report footing's first line is 'one greater than the final LINE-COUNTER setting established by the page footing report group', and that setting includes the PF's NEXT GROUP (§1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR5 a/b: the NEXT GROUP integer, or the sum of it and the PF's last line, goes into LINE-COUNTER); with no PF it is FOOTING + 1; b (RF ON NEXT PAGE): the HEADING line. ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute RF line above GroupLimits' upper bound (COBOL2199), but GroupLimits computes the report-footing bound as the 2023 rule (`MinimumLastLine(pageFooting) + 1`, the line after the PF's last line) at every edition, so the PF's NEXT GROUP never raises it at 85. Probes at --std 85, PAGE LIMIT 20 HEADING 3 FIRST DETAIL 4 LAST DETAIL 15 FOOTING 16: (b) PF LINE 17 + RF LINE 16 COBOL2199 (limit 18, right); no PF + RF LINE 16 COBOL2199 (limit 17, right), RF LINE 17 runs; RF LINE 2 ON NEXT PAGE COBOL2199 (limit HEADING 3, right), LINE 3 ON NEXT PAGE runs, RF on line 3; (f) relative arm: PF LINE 17 NEXT GROUP PLUS 1 + RF LINE PLUS 1 prints RF on line 19 (18+1, right). FAILS: PF LINE 17 NEXT GROUP 19 + RF LINE 18 (1985 limit 20) and PF LINE 17 NEXT GROUP PLUS 1 + RF LINE 18 (limit 19) both compile and print RF on line 18, directly under PF17, though LINE-COUNTER read 19 in the USE BEFORE REPORTING RF procedure. (a)(d)(e) do not reach a line-number limit. The witness (PF 17 without NEXT GROUP, relative RF) passes. kb/Work PB5244 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-50.json).

next.reason: 1985 a: after a page footing on the page the report footing's upper limit is 'one greater than the final LINE-COUNTER setting established by the page footing' (which includes the PF's NEXT GROUP, XIII.3.10.9 GR5a,b), else FOOTING+1; b: NEXT PAGE -> HEADING. 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 g) 'is the line following the last line of the page footing, if specified', or FOOTING+1 (also §2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 'begins after this line'); f) and §2023:13.18.39.4 GR4 keep HEADING for an RF on a page by itself. The PF's NEXT GROUP no longer raises the limit, so absolute RF lines between the PF's last line and its NEXT GROUP line become legal: looser.
